hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
cd services/picsure-dictionary
case $- in *x*) TRACE_WAS_ON=true ;; *) TRACE_WAS_ON=false ;; esac DICTIONARY_ENV=/usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/dictionary.env if [ ! -r "$DICTIONARY_ENV" ]; then echo "ERROR: cannot read $DICTIONARY_ENV" exit 2 fi set +x dictionary_setting() { sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$DICTIONARY_ENV" | tail -n 1 | tr -d '\r' } POSTGRES_HOST=$(dictionary_setting POSTGRES_HOST) POSTGRES_DB=$(dictionary_setting POSTGRES_DB) POSTGRES_USER=$(dictionary_setting POSTGRES_USER) POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(dictionary_setting POSTGRES_PASSWORD) rm -f db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.url=jdbc:postgresql://$POSTGRES_HOST:5432/$POSTGRES_DB" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.user=$POSTGRES_USER" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf echo "flyway.password=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" >> db/flyway/flyway.conf unset POSTGRES_PASSWORD if $TRACE_WAS_ON; then set -x fi
mkdir -p /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/sql/ cp -f db/flyway/flyway.conf /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/flyway.conf cp -f db/flyway/* /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/dictionary/sql/
docker run --rm --name dictionary-flyway \ --env-file /usr/local/docker-config/dictionary/dictionary.env \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/flyway/dictionary/sql/:/flyway/sql \ -v $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/flyway/dictionary/flyway.conf:/flyway/conf/flyway.conf \ --network dictionary \ flyway/flyway:11-alpine -connectRetries=60 repair
